master_prompt: A cinematic, ultra high-detail 2D digital stylized splash art illustration of {subject}, featuring a modern hybrid aesthetic (masterful mix of cartoon aesthetics and semi-realism). Adhere strictly to a 60/30/10 color palette: {primary_color} (60%), {secondary_color} (30%), and {accent_color} (10%). Use dynamic asymmetrical composition (Rule of Thirds), positioning the character to one side (left or right) to allow the background to reveal their narrative. Forms must be defined by light, value, and stylized color planes, with soft or no visible lineart. The background must feature simplified, symbolic silhouettes (like banners, iconic architecture, or emblems) that reflect the character's lore. Absolute focus on anatomical integrity, correct 5-finger hand structure, and strictly following the user-defined facial shape. Framing from head to mid-thigh (below the waistline).

meta.priorities: Narrative integration, asymmetrical balance, anatomical perfection, 2D hand-drawn look

distribution.primary_60: Dominant clothing/armor and overall environmental atmosphere
distribution.secondary_30: Secondary attire parts, equipment, and narrative background silhouettes
distribution.accent_10: Jewelry, magical essence, eyes, and fine metallic/glowing details

user_input_override.instruction: All user-defined traits must be fully integrated.

composition_system.layout: Extended half-body; Character positioned on right third of the frame; Hips fully visible; No legs/knees
composition_system.balance: Balance character weight with symbolic background elements on the opposite side
composition_system.camera_angle: Eye-level dramatic or slight low-angle for status and impact
composition_system.depth_control: Clear separation between character (with outline) and narrative background layer

rules: Incorporate iconic shapes (banners, structures, emblems) that represent the character's lore
Keep elements simplified and stylized to maintain AI focus on character anatomy
Background colors must be derived from the Primary (60%) and Secondary (30%) palette
Use symbolic elements to tell a story without adding technical visual clutter
Background must remain sharp and clean, serving as a supporting atmospheric layer

rendering_2d_standard.lineart: None visible or highly subtle (integrated into the color planes); forms defined by light and material contrast
rendering_2d_standard.shading: Masterful mix of stylized shadow planes and soft form-defining gradients
rendering_2d_standard.textures: Simplified material readability, no photorealistic skin or surface pores
rendering_2d_standard.brushwork: Refined digital brushstrokes with a painterly but polished finish

face_rules: Strictly follow the user-defined face shape (oval, triangular, round, etc.)
Sharp facial clarity with symmetrical features
Expressive eyes matching the character's lore

fail_safe.rule: If generation complexity increases, reduce environment detail first to protect character anatomy and facial integrity.
